# Split rent fairly when the rooms are not equal

> Free roommate rent calculator for rooms that are not equal. Everyone says what each room is worth to them; the tool assigns rooms and sets rents that add up to the total so that no one would swap. Private, in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/roommate-rent-splitter/)
- [How to split rent with unequal rooms, with a worked example](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/roommate-rent-splitter/how-to-split-rent-with-unequal-rooms.html)
